title: Planar herald decoder survey and integration
summary: Survey and reusable integration of configuration MAP, planar logical ML, transfer and controlled MPS on the classical herald channel over p,q in [0,1].
current_focus: Integrated decoder survey, independent validation and matched full-domain pilot are delivered.
next_action: Reuse the standard methods and retained matched vectors; new physical channels or phase sweeps require a separate contract.
motivation: Separate intrinsic logical recovery from posterior-inference and matching losses.
question: Which methods can become reusable standard decoders, and what do matched performance and runtime establish?

results.title: Fresh matched logical failure comparison
results.summary: Fresh 200 shared unconditional records per cell, Wilson95 intervals. Planar and transfer failure counts coincide; MPS χ16 approximate. High-p records independently sampled; no reflection or interpolation.

results.title: Conditional logical-risk objective gap
results.summary: Selected sector expected loss minus exact planar conditional Bayes risk, averaged over 200 records. Error bars ±1.96 sample SE. Exact reference zero; MPS posterior agreement is cohort-specific.

results.title: Warmed per-shot decoder latency
results.summary: Pooled equal-size fresh eight-cell mix:1600 timings/method/size, one CPU thread; excludes graph setup and independent first call. Median and p95, no claim of native or asymptotic speed.

results.title: MPS and Kac–Ward approximation diagnostics
results.summary: Maximum sampled posterior differences, not rigorous risk bounds. MPS finitechi and KacWard finitepenalty remain approximations. Plot floor1e-17 for zero/roundoff differences; no production threshold inferred.
